messages.text: Saturday, September 26 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Skies, Community Events Abound

An overcast but mild Saturday offers a range of local activities, from community gatherings in Ypsilanti to musical performances in Detroit. The University of Michigan advances cancer research with a new center.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 73°F and a low around 48°F.
Sunrise is at 7:26 AM, sunset at 7:24 PM, with a full moon, 99.7% illuminated.
Discover Local Flavors and Sounds
The Big Read Kickoff at YDL-Michigan Library Plaza begins at 11:00 AM, offering live performances and local history. For music lovers, The Ark in Ann Arbor hosts The Bros. Landreth at 7:30 PM.
September 30th marks both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor Council Allocates Downtown Lot Sale Funds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a plan to allocate between $14.2 million and $17.4 million from the sale of the Kline's lot. The funds will support 12 different projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy.
Sunday Offers Art and Comedy
Tomorrow, catch the Jazz Fest at The Ravens Club in Ann Arbor starting at 2:00 PM, or enjoy comedy with Colin Mochrie & Brad Sherwood at Sound Board at MotorCity Casino Hotel at 7:30 PM.
Soundwave Cancer Treatments Advance at U-M

The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to research soundwave-based cancer treatments. NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation.
The schedule for the next Starship launch is unset; Next Spaceflight estimates no earlier than September 18, 2026.
Seek out a quiet moment, and let the day unfold.
Sunday, September 27 · Canton, Michigan
Clear skies, warm breezes, and a full moon rise

A clear and warm autumn day offers a high of 76°F, perfect for outdoor activities. The local civic conversation centers on Ann Arbor's plans for downtown property sale funds, while science looks at autonomous satellite navigation.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 76°F and a low around 47°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:27 AM and sunset is at 7:22 PM, with a full moon rising at 7:35 PM, 99.5% illuminated.
Sunday's nearby cultural moments

In Ann Arbor, the Jazz Fest continues at The Ravens Club starting at 2 PM with free admission, and the Kerrytown Concert House hosts an artist reception for Esther Kirshenbaum at 4 PM and a musical event with Kathryn Goodson at 4 PM. For a different scene, consider the 'Chefs in the Garden' event in Ypsilanti at 5 PM.
This coming Wednesday, September 30, marks both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor's plan for downtown sale proceeds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. These funds will be allocated across 12 distinct projects.
Tomorrow and beyond: music, history, and nature
Tomorrow, consider the "118th Model T Birthday Party" in Detroit or the "Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit" in Ypsilanti. On Monday evening, catch Willi Carlisle at The Ark in Ann Arbor.
Satellites navigate without GPS, Roman telescope readies for launch

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. Additionally, NASA's Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review, targeting a launch in late August.
The next Starship launch is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026, though this is an independent estimate and not an official SpaceX schedule.
May the quiet hum of the day lead you to a moment of simple appreciation.
